partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Low-fanout causal target mechanism
results.hypothesis: Restricting the causal target to genes linked to at most 12 diseases removes literature-derived disease hubs while retaining specific causal mechanisms.
results.body: R017 plus causal gene disease degree <=12
results.mechanism_rationale: Retains direct target engagement and directional perturbation with a specific causal gene-disease link, but cannot distinguish therapeutic inhibition from disease-producing loss of function.
results.trapi_notes: The positive and adverse patterns are TRAPI-expressible; causal-gene degree and absence constraints require Cypher or post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
      -[:CAUSES]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND subject._miner_affects_aa_decreased_gene_degree <= 50
  AND COUNT { (gene)-[:CAUSES]->(:Disease) } <= 12
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT|CONTRAINDICATED_IN|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|CAUSES]->(object)
  }
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Independent clinical low-fanout mechanism
results.hypothesis: A specific causal-target mechanism plus an independently sourced clinical-trial assertion should retain validation hits while excluding disease-gene hubs and target-source leakage.
results.body: R022 plus causal gene disease degree <=12 and clinical-trial source infores:multiomics-clinicaltrials
results.mechanism_rationale: Combines specific target-level evidence with independent translational evidence, but still uses treatment-oriented evidence and lacks disease-mechanism direction.
results.trapi_notes: The positive motif and provenance are partly TRAPI-expressible; causal-gene degree and adverse-edge absence constraints require post-processing or Cypher.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
      -[:CAUSES]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (subject)-[trial:IN_CLINICAL_TRIALS_FOR]->(object)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND subject._miner_affects_aa_decreased_gene_degree <= 50
  AND COUNT { (gene)-[:CAUSES]->(:Disease) } <= 12
  AND 'infores:multiomics-clinicaltrials' IN coalesce(trial.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT|CONTRAINDICATED_IN|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|CAUSES]->(object)
  }
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id
